subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR wait for full-runner or gateway proof and explicit acceptance of the optional attempt-result field before merge?
rationale: The code shape looks sound, but contributor proof is still extracted and the PR changes compatibility-sensitive retry/session semantics that automation should not waive silently.

options.title: Require Proof And Contract Signoff
options.body: Wait for a clean rebase, redacted full-runner or gateway proof, and maintainer acceptance of the optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata field and retry ordering.

options.title: Override The Proof Gate
options.body: A maintainer may accept the predicate transcript and tests as enough proof, but that would intentionally waive the normal external-contributor real-behavior proof bar.

options.title: Reject This Field Shape
options.body: Pause this branch and ask for a different same-attempt side-effect signal if maintainers do not want the attempt result contract extended.

recommendation.title: Require Proof And Contract Signoff
recommendation.body: Wait for a clean rebase, redacted full-runner or gateway proof, and maintainer acceptance of the optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata field and retry ordering.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest recent history over the retry/replay area and plugin harness contract decisions sampled for this review.
